name: devmate-ai
description: DevMata AI - 통합 AI 개인 워크스페이스

scripts.setup: npm run db:generate -w apps/api && npm run db:deploy -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run stage -w apps/desktop && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
